xml_content: <TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" status="unreviewed" xml:id="exX0062023-05-2609-59-40">'di'i lan la | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">yab sras rnams</rs> na re | <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">kho bo cag</rs>  theg pa chen po pa yang tha snyad tshad 'bras kyi tshul 'di khyod mdo sde pa'i rjes su 'brang bar 'dod pa yin no zhes gsung ba ni | mi bden te | rigs pas de kho na'i don yongs su tshol ba'i skabs su rigs pa dor nas grub mtha'i rjes su 'brang ba ni | bya ba phal pa la chags pa zhes bya ba smad pa'i gnas su <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:unnamed_reference" ref="db:4593">slob dpon</rs> gyis kyang gsungs shing | gzhung na'ang | gzung dang 'dzin pa rig <lb n="40b2"/> pa rnams| ces theg pa chen po pas tha snyad tshad 'bras kyi rnam bzhag 'khrul pa'i shes pa la ji ltar snang bzhin du rnam par bzhag gi | grub mtha'i rjes su zhugs nas bzhag pa ni ma yin no ||</seg></TEI>
